source_title: Integrated disposal and processing technologies for mowed roadside grass (including energetic valorisation)
sponsor: OVAM; report executed by Bodemkundige Dienst van Belgie vzw
license: No explicit open reuse license identified in the public report. Do not claim CC licensing; retain attribution and check reuse terms before redistribution.
geography: Ravels, Belgium; roadside grass from narrow rural roads
observation_unit: One campaign-level summary describing four delivered loads; no four-row load-level dataset was reported.
evidence_class: B field observations as reported in an institutional study

column_metadata.reported_mass_per_load_value: Approximate reported load quantity; each was described as slightly below about 25 tonnes.
column_metadata.reported_mass_per_load_unit: Tonnes per delivered load; exact wet/dry basis is not explicitly stated in the passage.
column_metadata.maximum_interim_storage_days: About three days, based on contractor report; exact load-level timing was not independently measured.

handling: English-language field summary of the report. The four loads are not represented as independent observations. No total annual supply, dry-matter mass, contamination fraction, or storage loss is calculated.
major_limitations: No roadside area, route length, harvested area, crop yield per hectare, or access constraint was quantified for these loads.
Individual load weights and moisture/composition are unavailable; the load mass basis is not resolved in the cited passage.
Freshness, heat, fermentation odour, sand and litter are qualitative observations, not laboratory measurements.
One Belgian municipality and one 2008 campaign do not represent Dutch supply or seasonal availability.
content_rights_note: The source report PDF is not copied into the repository; only limited factual fields and traceability metadata are staged.
